introduction: Seven part series in which presenter Jo Sinnott rides a Triumph Bonneville motorcycle, challenging herself to explore Europe, wild camping all the way. On her journey she passes through Ireland, UK, France, Spain and Portugal. She meets an array of interesting and often eccentric characters and camps in some of the continent's most beautiful, unspoilt locations.乔骑着她的胜利牌摩托车就上路了，她的任务是从爱尔兰一路骑到葡萄牙。她所面临的挑战是，探索欧洲大陆但必须全程睡在荒野。一路上，她碰到了各路奇人，从艺术家音乐家到生存专家到野生动物爱好者。每到一处，就有人指引她去看当地最美的景色以及那些未经破坏的古迹。
